reasoning: The brief partial shutdown that began on January 31 came from House timing. The Senate had passed a package of five appropriations bills plus a two-week DHS continuing resolution. The House was expected to pass it in early February, ending that shutdown and funding DHS only through about February 13. Democrats were resisting full-year DHS funding after the Minneapolis ICE shooting, so a DHS lapse starting Saturday, February 14 looked likely. To my recollection, DHS funding did lapse on February 14, which would count as a new partial shutdown after a reopening. The main uncertainty is whether OPM's operating status page formally announced a DHS-only lapse, which keeps this from near-certainty.
